items.title: Pushouts of schemes along closed immersions exist, are fibre squares by closed immersions, and carry the structure-sequence
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: For closed immersions i : Z -> X and j : Z -> Y the lemma proves the pushout Y coproduct_Z X exists in schemes, the resulting square is cartesian, both legs into the pushout are closed immersions, and there is a short exact sequence 0 -> O_{Y coproduct_Z X} -> a_* O_X direct-sum b_* O_Y -> c_* O_Z -> 0. The retained proof is written as a specialization of the chapter's main pushout proposition (proposition-pushout-along-closed-immersion-and-integral, whose hypotheses are verified clause by clause): hypothesis (3) (integral with controlled fibres) is immediate because j is a closed immersion so its fibres are singletons; the closed-immersion property of both output legs comes from running the same proposition with the roles of the two arrows reversed (the author's explicit symmetry instruction); cartesianity and the exact sequence are the proposition's conclusions transported through the affine-local verification. Retained author proof at lines 20006-20014.
